title: Veilforge
tagline: A duskbound idle RPG of remnant crafts, war-arts, and the last workshop under a broken sky.
overall: Longevity wave 18: collection log, Codex, rarity, Echo ladder, bounty chains, dual modes, renewal, standing orders, challenge saves, Eclipse, Dawn. Unique Imagine cells still 28px. Still not a Melvor tutorial. Do not claim Melvor Idle 2 was beaten.

comparison.melvorIdle: Offline combat, vault halt, Dawn return, and a real completion log. First hour is still a beat scan, not Melvor's gated tutorial
comparison.melvorIdle2: Codex, drop 1/X, mastery milestones, and ~100 diaries exist; painted 24px atlas and a hosted hiscore board do not
comparison.runescape: Boss telegraphs, deeds, Echo climb, set bonus on the paperdoll. Meshes are still primitive dusk stubs
comparison.oursBetter: Telegraphed burst + mercy, per-mark Whisper heat, Echo as one Halt job, ledger whispers without gating content
comparison.biggestGap: painted 24px icon atlas vs lookalike Imagine cells; Melvor tutorial gate; authored act beats still short of 50–70

log: Wave 18: longevity — Codex/logbook, rarity, Echo, bounty chains, dual modes, renewal, orders, challenge saves, Eclipse, Dawn, CI.
Wave 17: critic pass G1–G8, G10, E1–E10, BEAT-1, A3/A6/A7 plus feasible A1/A2/A4/A5/A8–A10. Selftest collector. PWA v19.
Wave 17: burst telegraph + mercy; gather halt on dump; offline combat; per-mark Whisper heat; death modal; quay commissions.
Wave 17: persistable() strips _; SAVE_VERSION ladder; offline truncation flag; structured combatLog; firstHourBeat scan.
Wave 16: mobile app-shell (bottom dock, swipe skills, shorter scene, ledger hidden). Settings export/import. PWA v18.
Wave 16: skill-locked quay tiles dim like sold-out Auto-Eat; Pay stays disabled. Shop removed from the skill rail.
Wave 16: Lantern Quay is a Shop desk — keepers, dusk bargain (−18%), hunger pawn 72%.
Wave 16: quiet job cards + craft dock, Anvil/Fletch tabs, batch 1/5/10/25/All/Until halt.
Wave 16: full-review blockers; item icons follow kind (not gem-for-wood).
Wave 15: merge origin/main yield-drip with critic-wave Last yield + unique Imagine icons.
Wave 14: Goal strip with numbered first-hour chain; XP % on skill nav.
Wave 13: per-action +item/+xp drips; workshop floaters; offline skips drip spam.
Wave 12: SVG glyphs, monster kinds, dungeon gates, workshop paperdoll.
Wave 11: unique-skill identity, combat ops, vault ops.
